author: Kanwardeep Singh
description: Bareilly: The father of the minor girl sexually assaulted by self-styled godman Asaram Bapu -- serving life imprisonment in the case and currently out.
body_text: Bareilly: The father of the minor girl sexually assaulted by self-styled godman Asaram Bapu -- serving life imprisonment in the case and currently out on bail -- met senior police officers in Shahjahanpur requesting additional security for the family and an arms licence for his daughter. "Since Asaram is out of jail on bail, the risk to my family has increased as he can do anything with the support of his followers. He is managing everyone; even my lawyer didn't file any objection against the bail and cheated us," said the father, whose daughter was 16 years old when Asaram sexually assaulted her at his Jodhpur ashram in 2013. "My daughter had applied for a weapon licence, but her request was not accepted by the officials concerned at the place where she is currently living. Now, we will apply for the arms licence in Shahjahanpur," he said. Gujarat high court had on Friday extended temporary bail for three months to Asaram on medical grounds. Senior advocate Shalin Mehta, representing Asaram, argued that the 86-year-old was suffering from heart and kidney ailments, and the only treatment available to him was ayurvedic 'panchakarma'. The treatment at a Jodhpur-based Ayurvedic facility had only just begun and would take another three months, the lawyer told the court. On January 7, Supreme Court granted interim bail to Asaram till March 31 in this case registered by Gujarat police. As the three-month period was coming to an end on Monday, his lawyers moved the HC seeking bail for another three months, starting April 1. "I am surprised that the court is repeatedly granting interim bail to Asaram, first for seven days, then 12 days, then two and a half months, and now for three months. He also received a 17-day parole in Dec 2024 before obtaining his interim bail in Jan 2025. Though bail has been given on medical grounds, Asaram is visiting most parts of the country, and has travelled from Jodhpur to Indore, Ujjain and Surat to meet his followers. A man with 90% heart blockage is travelling to places, conducting kirtans etc," said the girl's father.
